meta.name: formax-dev-loop-workflow
meta.description: Use when working on Formax code changes and you need a disciplined dev loop: keep a single mainline task, avoid scope drift, run only targeted tests (no coverage), avoid partial staging (MM), run mandatory review before commit, include an incremental optimization check, and keep commits small and reviewable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 遵循纪律性开发循环，保持任务聚焦并控制变更范围
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Formax 项目上保持严谨的开发流程
copy.tagline_en: Follow a disciplined dev loop to stay focused and control scope
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a disciplined development workflow on Formax

howto.what: Claude 会按固定流程工作：每次只做一个任务，先写测试再实现，实现后检查能否简化代码，只运行针对性测试，提交前必须审查，保持提交小而清晰。
howto.when: 当你需要在 Formax 代码上执行有纪律的开发循环时触发，通常在你要求开始编码或测试时。

say.text: 开始一个 Formax 开发循环，处理下一个待办项。
say.note: Claude 会挑选一个主线任务并执行完整流程。

say.text: 帮我运行针对性测试，只测改动的文件。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a disciplined loop: picks one mainline task, writes tests first, implements the smallest change, checks for incremental optimization, runs targeted tests only, requires a mandatory review before commit, and keeps commits small and reviewable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are working on Formax code changes and need a disciplined dev loop, typically when you ask to start coding or testing.

say_en.text: Start a Formax dev loop, process the next TODO item.
say_en.note: Claude picks one mainline task and runs the full loop.

say_en.text: Run targeted tests only for changed files.
say_en.note: Claude uses bun run test:changed to run tests.
